item.title: Baolong Bi
item.description: I am a second-year Ph.D. student in Computer Science at Institute of Computing Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences, advised by Prof. Shenghua Liu and Yiwei Wang. I am a member of CAS Key Laboratory of AI Security. My research interests lie in the general area of trustworthy large language models.
